id./param/scenario/cs/c_020_cs_110.pack|cs_: "So you are Lady Serenica...

"Who is Serenica?
  Do you need something of me?

"The evil god has awakened.
  Lend us your strength to save the world.
"Save the world...?

"Remember, Lady Serenica.
  This is your flute.
"Ah... This flute...

"I remember this flute
  only faintly.

"But... the flute in my memory
  was filled with much more power.

"This flute plays only one melody.
  The Awakening Song passed down
  in the holy land...
"Sister, could it be...
"The time has come."
"Now is the time to awaken."
"The sky is yours.
"Soar high into the heavens!

"Amazing! Just like in the holy sapling!
  So this is Cetacea, awakened!

I am Cetacea.
Once I carried the Luminary Erdwin
on my back to fight the evil god Calasmos.
"That was Cetacea's voice...
"Shh. It's trying to say something.

The evil god Calasmos...
His strength is beyond imagination.

The Zwaardsrust Labyrinth...
Take on Neresen's trial and gain
strength to match the evil god.

My heart is with Erdwin...
With my power, you may break
the barrier.

"The Zwaardsrust Labyrinth, eh?
  Indeed, we should prepare before
  facing the evil god.

"No chance if we rush in, huh.
  Can't be helped. Let's build our strength.
  Let's go, {var:1}.
"Erdwin...?
